protocol.checkpoint_scope: The same current unified NanoJev checkpoint used in all four development demos

selection.rule: Restore the original fixed 50x50 Maze and 12x12, 256-move Snake showcases; run the current NanoJev checkpoint on those cases without searching for new outcomes.
selection.scope: Two fixed demonstrations; not a new aggregate benchmark

maze.prediction_cache: once per visited coordinate in a static maze
maze.selection_rule: untried p>=0.5 edges first; goal Manhattan distance, destination visits, descending p, N/E/S/W
maze.probe_rule: if all untried edges have p<0.5, physically attempt by descending p, goal Manhattan distance, destination visits, N/E/S/W
maze.reposition_rule: BFS to nearest frontier using only physically traversed open edges
maze.collision_rule: nonfatal; preserve position; mark the undirected edge blocked and never retry it
maze.fallback_definition: low-probability probes only; no full-map route or safe-action fallback
maze.memory_termination: all frontiers exhausted, goal reached, or attempt budget exhausted
maze.atomic_metric_scope: first-visit states chosen by this model-guided trajectory; not an identical cross-model audit cohort

snake.planner: actual next-step collision filter, then shortest static next-head path to current food; next body except head is blocked
snake.model_input: current physical state, action question, candidate descriptions only
snake.sample_rng: independent Python Random per episode, SHA256([episode_id, seed]) first 32 bits; one recorded draw per model decision
snake.attribution: food collection and survival use a common code planner; models choose only residual ties

protocol.reused_baselines: Original Jev and original Qwen runs; exact initial states, inputs, controllers and complete physical trajectories revalidated
protocol.probabilities: Maze uses four independent local-safety probabilities; Snake uses a conditional distribution over common-planner candidates
protocol.terminal_playback: Hold each system at its actual recorded terminal frame

limitation: Upstream recordings; metadata and browser replay checked, not new inference or independent simulator validation.
